body:
# Ping Overlay

[![](https://img.shields.io/discord/1525357108541919362?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white&label=Join%20Server)](https://discord.gg/zD2jUXsRDD)
![Ping/FPS display](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/078f9f1757b5db8b93f09ecea4822dbdfe0cd033.png)
## About

Displays your current ping and FPS on the right from your hotbar.

Client-side only. Requires Fabric Loader and Fabric API and Java 21+ (obviously).

Notes:
* May conflict with other HUD/GUI mods that render near the right of the hotbar
* Ping updates might be slow in some servers because they have that info ratelimited

Current supported versions: [26.2](https://modrinth.com/mod/ping-overlay/version/26.2+1.0.0), [1.21.11](https://modrinth.com/mod/ping-overlay/version/1.21.11+1.0.1)

Contact through our [Discord](discord.gg/zD2jUXsRDD) if you have any suggestions or issues
